judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements `accumulateUsage` and fulfills the functional requirements, spec updates in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and changelog entry. However, it missed one explicit acceptance criterion: updating the `afterModelResponse` signature so the parameter name or type unambiguously indicates cumulative usage (which the reference did by renaming `usage` to `totalUsage` in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and renaming the local variable `lastUsage` to `totalUsage`). Remarkably, the candidate identified this exact requirement in its own `.lore/dod.md` facets and checked the box, yet failed to make those edits in the actual code. Additionally, the candidate left behind the `.lore/dod.md` scratch file and created a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than placing tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` alongside existing tool loop tests.
